Millions mourn Iran's Supreme Leader at funeral procession in Tehran

Millions of people gathered in Tehran to pay their respects to Iran's former Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, with many expressing anger and calls for vengeance towards the US. The funeral procession was marked by chants of 'kill Trump' and displays of red flags. The event has significant implications for India's strategic relations with Iran.
